name: Kaelin Adesanya-Reid
education: Bachelor of Science in Environmental Science, Wayne State University
bio: Kaelin spends her weekdays inspecting industrial sites along the Detroit River, clipboard in hand and steel-toed boots laced tight. Sundays are sacred — she hosts a small watch party for Lions games where her homemade jerk chicken wings have become legendary among friends. She picked up speedrunning classic Sonic games during the pandemic and still streams casually on Twitch a few nights a month. Between possessing an inexplicable talent for identifying bird calls and her habit of journaling every morning before dawn, most people are surprised to learn she also restores vintage synthesizers in her garage.
